summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private path-resolution helper; exported it explicitly from monai/data/__init__.py; added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection after the Utilities entry in docs/source/data.rst; and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist covering the four required cases. Tests were not run and black/flake8 were not run, since the task forbids running repository code; I verified only that no new line exceeds 120 columns. Choices: typing was imported for the required hints despite the "only os and json" wording; isinstance(dict) was used for the mapping check; the "test" wrap happens before item validation. Nothing was committed.
